vulnerabilities.title: Timing Attack Vulnerability

vulnerabilities.title: Information Disclosure in Error Messages
vulnerabilities.description: Error messages reveal authentication mechanism details

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Development Mode Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Complete authentication bypass in development mode without safeguards

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Rate Limiting
vulnerabilities.description: No rate limiting allows brute force and timing attack amplification

vulnerabilities.title: Weak Confirmation Middleware
vulnerabilities.description: Predictable confirmation values and same timing vulnerability

immediate: Add rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks
short_term: Reduce information disclosure in error messages
long_term: Add CSRF protection for sensitive operations
Consider migration to JWT or OAuth 2.0
